connector.name: Post for Me MCP Pro
connector.registryDescription: Publish, schedule and analyze social posts across 9 platforms via the Post for Me API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package postforme-mcp-pro. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the helbertparanhos account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: POSTFORME_API_KEY
env.description: Post for Me API key (Dashboard - Settings - API Keys).

env.name: POSTFORME_READONLY
env.description: Set to 'true' to block all write tools.
